description: Add support for configurable Direct IO alignment to enable Neon's storage system to work correctly on systems with different disk block sizes. Currently, the system only supports 512-byte alignment, which causes I/O errors on hardware with 4096-byte block sizes. This feature will make the alignment configurable at build time while maintaining backward compatibility.
functional_requirements: Add cargo features to configure IO alignment (512-byte default, 4096-byte option) in the pageserver and pageserver_api crates
Make the default IO buffer alignment configurable via cargo features and use this value throughout the codebase instead of hard-coded constants
Update the vectored Direct IO read implementation to use the configured alignment value for chunk size calculations
Add build-time configuration to the Dockerfile to allow building images with different alignment settings
Add startup logging to display the configured IO buffer alignment for operational visibility
Fix validation logic in virtual file operations to use the configured alignment instead of hard-coded values
